name: Tokage no Shippo Kiri ~Kirenai Shippo~
original_name: 蜥蜴の尻尾切り ～切れないしっぽ～
source:
“I’ve reclaimed the tail I cut off…”

Inoue Shuu spots a girl with a sad expression on the train platform.
The girl, who he thought was a stranger, turns out to be someone he’d been trying to convince himself was a stranger. By the time he realizes she’s irreplaceable, she’s already running away.
Shuu pours all his strength into chasing her, grabbing her hand just before she jumps onto the tracks.
And then, he kisses her.
It’s the moment he reclaims Kidozaki Ibara, the “tail” he’d severed, and decides to share her fate.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013468.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
“我把断掉的尾巴拿回来了……”

井上修在站台上发现了一个表情悲伤的女孩。
那个他以为是陌生人的女孩，原来是他一直试图说服自己的陌生人。当他意识到她无可替代时，她已经逃跑了。
修用尽全力去追她，在她跳上铁轨之前抓住了她的手。
然后，他吻了她。
就在那一刻，他夺回了被他切断的“尾巴”木崎伊原，并决定与她分享命运。
